# fenykl

Loader flashed once, then C plugins from the SD card hook the firmware. E-M10 Mark II 1.4.

[Contribution home](https://github.com/atx/fenykl/issues). No release; the README calls it an early-stage experimental project, not ready for care-free users. The maintainer runs the loader and the main plugin on one E-M10 Mark II on firmware 1.4; the SDK's status table dates each camera run and names the parts that ran only in its simulator.
